contexts.text: Like a dancer who wants to learn to dance from a knowledge of the motor fibres and muscles. SE 3950.
In some of these Societies (of the mock Heaven of the Papists) they dance... SE 5213. SE 6012.
The adulterers went down into Hell as it were dancing.
A place where there are dances, etc. SE 5213. SE 6012.
They do nothing there but dance, etc.
Therefore the joy originating from the good of love is described and meant by dancing and skipping.
The mountains danced like rams ()... To dance (being predicated of the good of love) = to do goods from joy.

Locusts have legs above their feet to leap upon the earth ()... It is said to leap upon the earth, because when leaping is predicated of flying creatures, it = to live, as walking does when predicated of animals of the earth; and spiritual life is from the truths which are from good, which are signified by leaping with feet above which are legs.
David's dancing represented the gladness and joy which result from the affection of truth and good from the Lord through the influx of Divine truth, which was signified by the ark.
To dance () = joy from the filthy love which has adulterated the good of love.
There are diversions of charity... Dances at weddings, and at festive gatherings.
